tools.name: post_get_page_source
tools.description: Fetches and returns page source of provided url. Billing per call: 1 Credits.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "bypass-cloudflare-api" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_get_page_source · Public sink: post_get_page_source.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_get_page_source · Public sink: post_get_page_source

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
